prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE complete seamless-in-composition landscape environment painting for an existing bright hand-painted 2.5D action RPG, Amber Hive insect civilization. It is a full contiguous room environment background, NOT a sprite atlas and NOT a tileable texture.
Input image 1 is ONLY the reference for painterly rendering, gentle three-quarter near-isometric camera and fresh warm sunlight. Do not copy its HUD, characters, enemies, pickups, props, exact decorative layout or oversaturated yellow floor.
Create a new HIGH-RESOLUTION horizontal 3:2 composition, ideally 3072 x 2048. ONE unified scene, filled to every image edge. Opaque finished landscape background. No panels, no grid divisions, no text or user interface.
The main visual change: about 78% of image width and 74% of image height is calm, light, warm CREAM-IVORY walkable stone, not a saturated orange-yellow field. The empty playable rectangle spans normalized x 0.11–0.89 and y 0.13–0.87. Keep this entire center clear of any architecture, objects, furniture, characters or blocking plants. It is continuous flat DRY stone with large gracefully varied irregular slabs, subtle hand-painted cream material and VERY FAINT honeycomb engravings in a few slabs. Seams are sparse, natural, restrained warm beige; no dark repetitive cracks, busy noise, mirrored patterns, checkerboard or stamped repeating tiles. Low warm shadows keep characters readable when composited later. Tiny flecks of light green moss may occur only where the center merges into outer perimeter.
Composition and ground colors: warm cream ivory (#F6E6C0), pale honey limestone, restrained beige shadow (#DEC78F), tender green giant-leaf accents (#95B56A), only small vivid violet-wing flower touches (#8E69AD), and translucent amber roots (#D7A653) in the OUTER scenery. The floor should read 70% light cream, 20% pale honey beige and only 10% gentle natural detail. Bright sunlit color, neither white sterile nor orange mustard.
Integrated perimeter: the outer approximately 8–12% of the frame is a painterly natural insect hive-valley landscape. Organic curved low chitin/wax remnants, subtle irregular cream beeswax honeycomb ledges, amber root formations and broad fresh green leaves melt naturally into the same stone ground. Complete all FOUR scene edges within the SAME painting. Use varied composition: a few amber root outcrops at upper-left, gentle leafy hive-valley slope at upper-right, scattered low creamy shell ledges in lower-right and rich green leaf/pollen groundcover at lower-left. Do not repeat the same item in a row, assemble a fence out of identical prefabs or make a rectangular enclosure. No clearly straight horizontal color strips or perfectly rectangular rim.
At LEFT MIDDLE and RIGHT MIDDLE, leave WIDE uninterrupted stone entrance/exit corridors extending all the way to the frame edge, approximately y 0.36–0.64. No posts, fence, rail, leaf canopy or roots across these passages. The stone blends naturally into low side flowers and distant warm hive-valley environment. Frame top and bottom softly with irregular natural foliage and small curved low chitin features; no top or bottom solid-color band.
Perspective: a calm HIGH-ANGLE THREE-QUARTER near-isometric look matching a playable 2.5D game, center ground broad and not foreshortened excessively. Show a little dimensional wax/shell edge and leaf-root slope only outside the reserved play rectangle. No deep canyon, abyss, big water pool, raised central island, sheer cliff or tall wall. Giant leaves appear at the outermost corners and their stems remain outside the play rectangle. Warm sunlight comes from upper left with soft pale lavender shadows, fresh garden atmosphere.
Important game integration: later runtime sprites will supply all beacons, nests, crates, carts, statues, banners, market stalls and other furniture. This painting includes NONE of those. No humanoid, animal, insect character, queen, eggs, collectible crystal, loot, chest, torch, beacon or freestanding architectural furniture. Landscape plants and naturally embedded wax/chitin/root geology only. No decorative pillars, arch gates, stairs or stand-alone structures.
Avoid: HUD, text, labels, logo, watermark, sprite-sheet rows, repeating border sprites, solid-color horizontal bands, black/grey empty outside area, gold vertical stripes, straight box-shaped walls, saturated yellow-orange floor, tiled/repeating surface, overly busy moss or cracks, rectangular holes or water reservoirs, stretched textures, industrial machinery, standalone objects, cast deep dark shadows, dark fantasy or gore.
